prompt:
Bug: the recipe image upload accepts any file type and fails with a 500.

PUT /api/recipes/{slug}/image takes the file (image) and its type (extension, a form field). The extension is never checked. An upload declared as svg, svg+xml, pdf, mp4 or exe, or with the extension ".", goes on to image processing and fails with an internal server error. A file declared as png whose bytes are not an image also fails with a 500.

Expected:
- The extension is checked before anything is processed, ignoring case and a leading dot. Accepted are the raster formats the image minifier turns into webp: jpg, jpeg, jpe, jfif, png, webp, heic, avif, gif, bmp, tif and tiff. Any other extension (svg, svg+xml, pdf, mp4, exe, ".") answers 400 with a detail.message that contains "Unsupported image file type" (ideally also naming the type and the supported ones).
- An accepted extension with bytes that are not a readable image answers 400 with detail.message exactly "Uploaded file is not a valid image".
- After either 400 the recipe's image is unchanged (it stays null on a recipe that had none).
- Good uploads still answer 200 with a non-empty image key: a JPEG sent as "JPG", a PNG as "png", and GIF and BMP images as "gif" and "bmp".

Tests: `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration_tests/user_recipe_tests/test_recipe_image_assets.py` for quick loops; the whole backend suite is `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests` (about 8 minutes).
title: fix: validate image type on recipe hero image upload (#8498)
